lessons: When generating a standalone HTML dashboard, always embed all CSS inline and avoid any external dependencies.
When responding to code‑generation requests, provide the complete solution exactly in the format specified and omit any extra explanations or commentary.
Always provide a complete, self‑contained HTML file with all necessary inline CSS to fully implement the requested layout and styling.
Always deliver the requested technical architecture analysis in structured markdown, covering memory management, provider routing, self‑healing, failure modes, and scaling.
Always deliver fully functional, self‑contained code (e.g., HTML with inline CSS) accompanied by a clear, objective analysis of its design and behavior.
